observation.command:
echo "=== dokumente-api deployment ==="; grep -E "dokumente" /opt/tomcat-api/logs/catalina.out | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -E "finished|Error|SEVERE|failed" | tail -4
echo "=== dokumente root ==="; timeout 30 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-dokumente-api/"
echo "=== rabbitmq ==="; export RABBITMQ_NODENAME=rabbit@localhost; rabbitmqctl status 2>/dev/null | grep -E "RabbitMQ version|Uptime" 
echo "=== executor ==="; ps aux | grep "[v]alidator-executor" | awk '{print $2}' | head -1
echo "=== db schema count ==="; su - postgres -c "psql -d xplanbox -t -c \"SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name NOT IN ('pg_catalog','pg_toast','information_schema','pg_temp_0','pg_toast_temp_0');\""
